channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

image.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu

item.title: Citizens asked to detail demographic changes in their areas through MHA portal
item.description: Portal seeks input on changes caused by illegal immigration and other external factors; information sought from Central, State government bodies, NGOs and academics, international organisations, and ordinary citizens

item.title: ’Blue drum’ murder case: Meerut court sentences wife, partner to death
item.description: Justice requires punishment proportionate to the gravity of the oence, says judge referring to the Mahabharata; Saurabh was killed on March 3 last year, his body was discovered 2 weeks later

item.title: Telangana govt. giving less than 8 hours power supply with interruptions to farm needs: Harish Rao
item.description: He visit Gattu substation in Gadwal districts, examines logbook for details on farm power supply

item.title: Engineering, management courses offer diverse career opportunities, says Expert
Marco Rubio to skip Delhi, visit Mumbai and Jamnagar next week
item.description: His Jamnagar Reliance refinery visit will come a day after U.S. President is expected to take a decision on sanctions on Russian oil imports

item.title: Cardiology dept. in Kozhikode MCH in need of critical care
item.description: Though the sanctioned permanent staff strength of doctors is 14, only eight are on the rolls, and one of them has been sent on a working arrangement basis to the Government MCH, Wayanad

item.title: Koder House fire under fresh scrutiny amid probe into synagogue arson
item.description: Police say there is no information directly linking the Koder House fire to the synagogue arson; forensic examination awaited to establish whether a short circuit caused the blaze at the heritage property; Koder House remains closed; restoration and reopening may require heritage and archaeological clearances

item.title: CMFRI’s STI hub helps set up 84 micro-enterprises in eight districts
item.description: Initiative directly benefits 469 people, including 220 women and six transpersons; household incomes of beneficiaries rise by 30% to 35%, according to CMFRI communication

item.title: Complaint over suspected smuggling of fake cigarettes at Kempegowda International Airport
Bengaluru Metro facilitates swift transport of vital organ for medical emergency
item.description: The organ was transported from Sparsh Hospital in Yeshwantpur to Apollo Hospital in Seshadripuram.

item.title: Agriculture department seizes pesticides worth ₹3.12 lakh in Bengaluru
item.description: The officials seized three types of pesticides: chlorpyrifos, malathion and bifenthrin

item.title: Petitions in Supreme Court allege police excesses during Delhi CEC protests
item.description: Detainees demand independent inquiry into police action, preservation of CCTV footage and return of their phones and other belongings

item.title: Sometimes, to give peace to the living, the dead would have to be disturbed, says Madras High Court
item.description: Justice V. Lakshminarayanan orders exhumation of a body for DNA profiling and confirms it to be that of the son of a mourning couple before the court

item.title: TNPDCL will incur additional cost of ₹5 crore to ₹7 crore per day for purchase of gas power: Nirmal Kumar
item.description: Only 1,000 MW has to be procured, that too only to meet the evening peak demand, for 16 days from October 15 to 31, says Energy Resources Minister

item.title: Northeast monsoon to set in over Tamil Nadu on October 15, bring widespread rain till October 20: Regional Meteorological Centre
item.description: Northeast monsoon is expected to bring fairly widespread rainfall over the State till October 20, putting an end to the extended spell of soaring temperatures in interior districts

item.title: Children of police personnel receive ₹58.30 lakh in incentive awards
Short-Term Warehousing Solution introduced at BLR Logistics Park by AISATS
Supreme Court to hear Rahul Gandhi, Oppn. leaders’ plea against CEC Gyanesh Kumar and SIR on Oct. 15
item.description: Opposition petition seeks disclosure of Election Commissioners’s objections on SIR

item.title: DGCA bans specific power bank on flights
item.description: The directive comes after a power bank exploded in the overhead cabin of an IndiGo flight on October 11

item.title: CM warns Energy department officials of action, including suspensions, if power interruptions are reported
item.description: Mr. Revanth Reddy expressed his displeasure over interruptions

item.title: CBI arrests executive director of defence firm for graft
item.description: CBI registered the case against Anil Kumar following allegations that he connived with private parties and demanded and accepted illegal gratification for extending official favours

item.title: Prashanth to carry golden howdah in this year’s Jamboo Savari
item.description: Dhananjaya named reserve ambari elephant; Abhimanyu will be Nishane elepahant

item.title: CJP leaders Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka sent to five-day judicial custody over Jantar Mantar protest
item.description: Police register two FIRs against 14 party members, alleging trespass and obstruction of police personnel; CJP founder Abhijit Dipke accuses Modi government of imposing an “unofficial Emergency”

item.title: Hyderabad’s Uppal stadium turns sea of blue as city hosts international cricket after two years
Vijay launches ₹3,108-cr. ring main pipeline project for equitable drinking water supply
item.description: The project will interlink all nine water treatment facilities to ensure uninterrupted supply to residents of the GCC area. It involves laying 91.2 km of interconnected pipelines and installing instruments to measure water pressure, flow, and quality at treatment plants and distribution stations

item.title: Satyagraha for Constitution-as-commons
item.description: The resisters out on the streets today are those who hold Gandhi’s talisman and Ambedkar’s Preamble in their fight to restore to the people of this country control over their lives

item.title: Man killed as lorry rams two-wheeler in Tiruvannamalai
item.description: Special teams have been formed to nab the lorry driver, who is absconding

item.title: Two held for cheating in Vellore
item.description: Around 1,080 grams of fake jewellery were recovered from them

item.title: Yards to be set up for seized vehicles in every taluk: Minister
VIT to install 65 LED streetlights on Sathuvachari-VIT High Road in Vellore town to prevent accidents
item.description: The initiative by VIT comes after The Hindu report highlighted the plight of hundreds of motorists and pedestrians in using the new stretch without streetlights

item.title: Directorate of Revenue Intelligence seizes ₹30 crore worth of salt smuggled from Pakistan
item.description: Following the Pahalgam terror attack in April 2025, the Indian government had banned the direct or indirect import or transit of all goods originating in or exported from Pakistan, in the interest of national security and public policy

item.title: Sudden showers in Vellore, nearby districts
item.description: Heavy rain damaged Tangedco poles and strong winds uprooted trees in these areas on Wednesday

item.title: Meerut ‘blue drum’ murder case: Court sentences victim’s wife, her partner to death
item.description: The duo killed Mr Rajput, dismembered his body and concealed the remains in a blue drum before leaving for Himachal Pradesh

item.title: SIC to seek explanation from Kochi Corporation over move to share RTI applicants’ details
item.description: Commission says the reported move could deter people from seeking information under the RTI Act; Kochi Corporation had decided to refer details of frequent RTI applicants to the Vigilance for a probe into their financial backgrounds; SIC to seek a copy of the Corporation’s resolution, if any, and decide on the issue after receiving its response

item.title: Delhi HC seeks FSSAI’s stand in PIL case against non-dairy, analogue paneer
item.description: Gujarat, Punjab, Chhattisgarh and Maharashtra have already taken steps against non-dairy paneer, the plea says, seeking directions to prevent the supply of dairy analogue paneer in the national capital

item.title: Delhi-bound Air India flight issues ‘squawk’ hijack alert, diverted to Jaipur
item.description: Under international aviation protocols, squawk code 7500 indicates unlawful interference, including a hijack situation; airline sources dispute that the pilots had deliberately entered the hijack code

item.title: Kochi Mayor elected to global climate alliance’s board
item.description: GCoM brings together more than 14,000 cities and local governments from 150 countries across six continents, representing over 1.2 billion people worldwide

item.title: Centre sets up panel to study problems of sugarcane farmers
item.description: Representatives of sugarcane farmers from Karnataka and Maharashtra had met Union Ministers demanding that the government must increase remunerative returns to sugarcane farmers

item.title: Rahul, Priyanka Gandhi meet murdered Ankita Bhandari’s parents as they protest Sikkim Governor appointment
item.description: Bhandari was murdered while working at a resort for refusing to provide “special services” to a VIP guest; her parents allege that new Sikkim Governor Dushyant Kumar Gautam was the VIP, which he has denied

item.title: Three rebel SP MLAs join BJP in U.P.
item.description: Even after years of waiting, they received nothing more than a membership slip, Akhilesh said

item.title: Anti-CEC protest highlights: Anti-SIR protests rock Delhi for the fifth day, hundreds detained
item.description: Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke has called for a ‘Lehra Do Tiranga’ gathering at Central Park, Connaught Place, in Delhi, on October 16

item.title: ‘Enormous potential’ for India-Canada ties amidst global uncertainty: Canadian Foreign Minister
item.description: Minister Anita Anand is in India along with Minister of International Trade Maninder Sidhu for engagements with External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar and Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal; the Canadian Minister indicated that PM Modi would visit Canada later in December

item.title: Don’t stand in the way of protesting students, they are voice of India: Rahul tells PM and HM
item.description: LoP Rahul Gandhi made these remarks after interacting with students, including activists of the party’s students’ wing, National Students’ Union of India (NSUI), who were injured during recent protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over the weekend

item.title: Delhi journalist who accused ACP of sexual harassment slapped with SC/ST Act over ‘casteist remarks’
item.description: Delhi Police register FIR on ACP Vivek Bhagat’s complaint alleging caste-based humiliation and obstruction of duty; journalist’s sexual harassment complaint remains under Crime Branch inquiry

item.title: Rajnath Singh calls for deeper India-ASEAN defence cooperation, joint development of military technologies
item.description: Seeks mutual trust, respect for sovereignty, adherence to international law and open channels of dialogue to address conventional and emerging security threats

item.title: Supreme Court mandates insurance on offline railway tickets from October 27
item.description: ‘At present, only persons purchasing tickets online are provided the benefit of insurance coverage upon payment of a nominal additional amount’

item.title: HC grants bail to accused in Kavin caste killing case
item.description: Jayapal had filed an appeal against an order of the II Additional District Judge (PCR), Tirunelveli, declining to grant him bail

item.title: KTR accuses Congress of weakening SCCL
Dingaleshwar Swami joins protest of sugarcane farmers, questions Prime Minister Narendra Modi on different yardstick for oil companies
item.description: Fakira Dingaleshwara Swami, seer of Shirahatti Fakkireshwar Mutt, questions discrimination against farmers, cites quick decisions taken by Union Government on oil price hike

item.title: BJP Mahila Morcha approaches NCW over ‘sexual harassment’ case against Congress MP
item.description: The delegation submitted a memorandum to NCW chairperson Vijaya Rahatkar seeking action against former JNU professor Akoijam, over complaints filed by 11 female students

item.title: Questions over publicly unavailable prohibitory orders amid Delhi protest detentions
item.description: Delhi Police claim hoardings put up and announcements being made informing people about curbs; petition in Supreme Court alleges police “mischievously” failed to upload prohibitory order on their website

item.title: Four-day Yoga Dasara gets under way in Mysuru
Aluva DySP Baiju Paulose to investigate Nedumbassery car accident case
item.description: State Excise Commissioner suspends the licences of three bars in Ernakulam on the charge of serving liquor to the accused aged under 23

item.title: UNESCO team to visit Hampi on Oct. 24
item.description: It will carry out inspection with focus on conservation and management of heritage monuments

item.title: Accused wife faces public wrath during evidence collection
Cabinet clears ₹53,428 cr. for social assistance programme till 2030-31, drops ‘Indira Gandhi’ from pension scheme names
item.description: Critics question fixed five-year allocation for social pensions, saying it fails to account for rising beneficiary numbers and inflation

item.title: Notification issued for 2,721 teacher posts through DSC-2026
item.description: Visit the official website, https://tet2dsc.apcfss.in, for brief notification issued by the Director of School Education

item.title: Kerala HC denies temporary stay on toll collection at Nattika Fee Plaza
item.description: The court reiterated its order in another PIL filed by former MP T.N. Prathapan challenging the same toll collection

item.title: Sudha Pillai panel submits report on KIIFB
item.description: The terms of reference of the panel included recommending measures for restructuring KIIFB, redeploying its institutional capacities within the government, and laying out future courses of action regarding subsidiary or spin-off entities established by KIIFB

item.title: President Droupadi Murmu worships at Goddess Kanaka Durga temple in Vijayawada
item.description: She will inaugurate SARAS Mela in Vijayawada on October 15 and have lunch with members of SHGs and Lakhpati Didis
